title: ORACLE Psi possibility engine audit hardening in progress
summary: The draft ORACLE latent-pressure / ICARUS Psi possibility engine was audited before merge. A JavaScript selector regression was repaired and the research model was hardened so evidence coverage is confidence-weighted, external observation timestamps must be timezone-explicit and non-future, exactly neutral latent pressure cannot emit a directional phase boundary, and forced-consensus requires distinct evidence domains instead of counting correlated microstructure features as independent confirmation. Exact-head CI is still required before readiness or merge.
evidence: possibility-ui selector syntax regression repaired before merge
coverage now weights available evidence by confidence
forced consensus collapses correlated microstructure features into one evidence domain
external observed_at requires RFC3339 timezone and rejects future timestamps
neutral latent pressure no longer creates directional phase boundary
verification state: awaiting exact-head Linux/Windows CI
